notes.title: Important News about Umi Plushie
notes.content:
[h3]Hi everyone, the official date for the design release and final campaign launch has been moved[/h3]

We're working together with the Makeship team to ensure that the plushie looks as good as possible and perfectly represents our little bunny demon.
We've been making some adjustments to the physical design, but unfortunately that has meant a delay on the final campaign release, the official date being now early 2025 (January if everything goes well).

The link for the campaign remains the same: [url=https://www.makeship.com/petitions/umi-plush]https://www.makeship.com/petitions/umi-plush[/url]

Sorry for the troubles and please look forward to it!! ꒰ᐢ. .ᐢ꒱₊˚⊹

[i]Lonely House team[/i]

notes.title: Umi Plushie Initial Campaign. ݁₊ ⊹ . ݁˖ . ݁
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone, we're happy to announce we are hosting a Plushie campaign with Makeship![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44879394/e752fb2dd565475509d23f951f8b262d6fba910f.png[/img]

First stage is an initial petition to kickstart the plushie: [url=https://www.makeship.com/petitions/umi-plush]https://www.makeship.com/petitions/umi-plush[/url]

The way this works is:
[list]
[*] This petition only lasts [b]10 days![/b]
[*] For the petition to be succesful, we need [b]200 pledges[/b] before it ends. 
[*] [b]Each pledge is $2[/b] which, if the goal is not reached, will be fully refunded (and the plushie will not be made ૮ ◞ ﻌ ◟ ა)
[*] If successful, the remaining $27.99 of the plushie (+ shipping and tax) will be charged on November 16, 2024, when the final product design is launched. 
[/list]
Many fans have expressed the wish for a plushie so please help us make it come true₊ ⊹ . ݁˖ . ݁ Don't miss the once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to have Umi haunt you in your home!

EDIT:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44879394/0d4bb5dd4cb6dfccfcaca4e6df2cecb503cd4061.png[/img]
The campaign has been succesfully funded!! Thank you everyone for your support once again!  ₍ᐢ.  ̫.ᐢ₎₊‧.°.⋆✮⋆.°.‧₊
The campaign will still be running until the 10 days are completed so you can still get the plushie if you want to. Please look forward to bringing this silly bunny to your home!

notes.title: Rental Short Story Contest
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone! We're happy to announce a new contest, where you can write a short stories about Rental![/h1]

[b]The rules are as follows :[/b]

The short stories may be a maximum of a 100 words, inspired by a writing contest that is held in our city in Chile

You can use the characters or the world of Rental, feel free to do what you want as long it is in the world of Rental and follows the rules.

We'll have 2 winners, one will be voted among the devs, the other will be chosen by popular vote on the discord server. Each winner will get a 15.000CLP/15USD STEAM giftcard as a prize.

No NSFW. No outright gore. No AI generated content.

Send your submissions through the forum Short Story channel on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/ytcsw3A6td]discord server.[/url] 

Submissions that don't follow the rules will be deleted, be mindful of what you upload.

Deadline is 27 of may 23:59, Chilean time (20:59 PST). 

Have fun! (ᴗ͈ˬᴗ͈)ꕤ.ﾟWe can't wait to see what you come up with✶⋆.˚꩜ .ᐟ˙⋆✶!
